resource.name: aws_sagemaker_space
resource.description: Provides a SageMaker AI Space resource.
resource.llm_summary: The `aws_sagemaker_space` resource enables the creation and management of SageMaker Studio Spaces, providing isolated, collaborative environments for data scientists and machine learning teams to build, train, and deploy models. It is commonly used to set up secure, multi-user workspaces with customizable configurations for user access, resource policies, and integration with SageMaker Studio features. This resource supports lifecycle management, fine-grained access control, and seamless integration with AWS services, making it ideal for organizations looking to streamline ML workflows and enhance team productivity.

examples.title: Basic usage
examples.llm_summary: "Demonstrates the basic configuration of the `aws_sagemaker_space` resource by creating a SageMaker Space within an existing SageMaker Domain using the `domain_id` and `space_name` arguments. This example helps users understand how to set up a workspace for collaborative machine learning and data science in AWS SageMaker."

arguments.name: domain_id
arguments.description: (Required) The ID of the associated Domain.
arguments.llm_summary: The `domain_id` argument specifies the unique identifier of the SageMaker Domain to which the SageMaker Space belongs, enabling the association of the space with a specific managed environment for machine learning. This is a required parameter that ensures the space is correctly linked to the desired Domain, facilitating resource organization, user access, and collaboration within the SageMaker ecosystem.

arguments.name: id
arguments.llm_summary: The `id` argument for the `aws_sagemaker_space` resource allows users to specify a unique identifier for the SageMaker space, which serves as a distinct reference for the resource within AWS. Setting this argument helps define or retrieve the space's identity, enabling operations like resource management, updates, or integrations with other AWS services.

arguments.name: space_display_name
arguments.description: (Optional) The name of the space that appears in the SageMaker AI Studio UI.
arguments.llm_summary: The `space_display_name` argument for the `aws_sagemaker_space` resource allows users to define a user-friendly, customizable name for the SageMaker space as it appears in the SageMaker Studio UI. This enhances the visibility and organization of the space, making it easier for users to identify and manage different spaces within the Studio environment.

arguments.name: space_name
arguments.description: (Required) The name of the space.
arguments.llm_summary: The `space_name` argument specifies the unique name of the SageMaker space, allowing users to define and identify a dedicated environment for collaboration and resource organization within SageMaker Studio. Setting this argument is essential for creating and managing isolated workspaces tailored to specific teams, projects, or workflows.

arguments.name: tags
arguments.description: (Optional) A map of tags to assign to the resource. If configured with a provider `default_tags` configuration block present, tags with matching keys will overwrite those defined at the provider-level.
arguments.llm_summary: The `tags` argument allows users to assign key-value metadata to the `aws_sagemaker_space` resource, enabling resource organization, cost allocation, and environment identification. When used alongside a provider-level `default_tags` configuration, it ensures resource-specific tags can override default tags, providing flexibility in tagging strategies.

arguments.name: tags_all
arguments.llm_summary: The `tags_all` argument for the `aws_sagemaker_space` resource allows users to define a comprehensive set of key-value tags that are applied to the SageMaker space and any associated resources for organizational, billing, or management purposes. By setting this argument, users can ensure consistent tagging across resources, enabling streamlined resource categorization, cost allocation, and governance within their AWS environment.

blocks.name: ownership_settings
blocks.description: (Optional) A collection of ownership settings. Required if `space_sharing_settings` is set. See `ownership_settings` Block below.

arguments.name: owner_user_profile_name
arguments.description: (Required) The user profile who is the owner of the private space.
arguments.llm_summary: The `owner_user_profile_name` argument specifies the SageMaker user profile that owns and manages the private space within the `ownership_settings` of an `aws_sagemaker_space` resource. By defining this required parameter, users establish ownership and control over the space, enabling personalized configurations, access permissions, and resource management tied to the designated user profile.

blocks.llm_summary: The `ownership_settings` block in the `aws_sagemaker_space` resource defines ownership and access control configurations, enabling management of user permissions and resource sharing within a SageMaker space. This block is essential for specifying ownership rules when `space_sharing_settings` is enabled, ensuring proper governance and collaboration in multi-user environments.

blocks.name: space_settings
blocks.description: (Required) A collection of space settings. See `space_settings` Block below.

arguments.name: app_type
arguments.description: (Optional) The type of app created within the space.
arguments.llm_summary: The `app_type` argument in the `space_settings` block of the `aws_sagemaker_space` resource allows users to specify the type of application to be created within the SageMaker space, such as Jupyter notebooks or other supported app types. Configuring this argument defines the functionality and environment of the space, enabling users to tailor it to specific workflows or development needs.

blocks.name: code_editor_app_settings
blocks.description: (Optional) The Code Editor application settings. See `code_editor_app_settings` Block below.

blocks.name: app_lifecycle_management
blocks.description: (Optional) Settings that are used to configure and manage the lifecycle of JupyterLab applications in a space. See `app_lifecycle_management` Block below.

blocks.name: idle_settings
blocks.description: (Optional) Settings related to idle shutdown of Studio applications. See `idle_settings` Block below.

arguments.name: idle_timeout_in_minutes
arguments.description: (Optional) The time that SageMaker AI waits after the application becomes idle before shutting it down. Valid values are between `60` and `525600`.
arguments.llm_summary: The `idle_timeout_in_minutes` argument allows users to define the duration (in minutes) that SageMaker waits before automatically shutting down an application after it becomes idle, enabling control over resource lifecycle and cost optimization. By configuring this setting, users can balance application availability with efficient resource utilization, with valid values ranging from 60 minutes to 1 year.

blocks.llm_summary: The `idle_settings` block in the `aws_sagemaker_space` resource under "app_lifecycle_management" configures parameters for automatically shutting down idle Studio applications, optimizing resource usage and cost management. By defining idle timeout behaviors, this block enables users to enforce lifecycle rules for inactive application sessions, ensuring efficient operation and reducing unnecessary cloud expenses.

The `app_lifecycle_management` block within `code_editor_app_settings` for the `aws_sagemaker_space` resource configures and manages the lifecycle of JupyterLab applications in a SageMaker space. It encapsulates settings for controlling application initialization, updates, and termination processes, enabling users to define custom lifecycle behaviors and streamline the management of development environments for data science and machine learning workflows.

blocks.name: default_resource_spec
blocks.description: (Required) The default instance type and the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the SageMaker AI image created on the instance. See `default_resource_spec` Block below.

arguments.name: instance_type
arguments.description: (Optional) The instance type.
arguments.llm_summary: The `instance_type` argument in the `default_resource_spec` of the `aws_sagemaker_space` resource allows users to specify the compute instance type for the SageMaker space environment. This determines the underlying hardware configuration, such as CPU and memory, impacting the performance and cost of the environment used for running machine learning workloads or applications.

arguments.name: lifecycle_config_arn
arguments.description: (Optional) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Lifecycle Configuration attached to the Resource.
arguments.llm_summary: The `lifecycle_config_arn` argument allows users to specify the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of a SageMaker Lifecycle Configuration to attach to the `default_resource_spec` within an `aws_sagemaker_space`. This configuration defines custom scripts or actions to automate environment setup, resource initialization, or maintenance tasks, enabling tailored lifecycle management for the associated SageMaker resources.

arguments.name: sagemaker_image_arn
arguments.description: (Optional) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the SageMaker AI image created on the instance.
arguments.llm_summary: The `sagemaker_image_arn` argument in the `default_resource_spec` of the `aws_sagemaker_space` resource allows users to specify the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of a SageMaker AI image to be used for the instance. By setting this argument, users can define the pre-configured environment or runtime for their SageMaker space, enabling tailored machine learning workflows or development environments based on the selected image.

arguments.name: sagemaker_image_version_alias
arguments.description: (Optional) The SageMaker AI Image Version Alias.
arguments.llm_summary: The `sagemaker_image_version_alias` argument allows users to specify an alias for a specific version of a SageMaker AI image within the `default_resource_spec` configuration of the `aws_sagemaker_space` resource. By setting this alias, users can streamline image version management, enabling consistent references to a particular image version for their SageMaker space environment, which is useful for maintaining reproducibility and simplifying updates.

arguments.name: sagemaker_image_version_arn
arguments.description: (Optional) The ARN of the image version created on the instance.
arguments.llm_summary: The `sagemaker_image_version_arn` argument allows users to specify the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of a specific image version to be used for the SageMaker instance within the `default_resource_spec` configuration. By setting this argument, users can control the runtime environment, including pre-installed libraries and dependencies, ensuring compatibility and consistency for machine learning workflows or custom applications deployed in the SageMaker space.

blocks.llm_summary: The `default_resource_spec` block within the `code_editor_app_settings` of the `aws_sagemaker_space` resource defines the default compute environment by specifying the instance type and the ARN of the SageMaker AI image to be used. This block enables users to configure the foundational resources required for running the code editor application, ensuring the appropriate environment is provisioned for development and AI workloads.

The `code_editor_app_settings` block within the `space_settings` of the `aws_sagemaker_space` resource configures the environment and features for the integrated code editor application in SageMaker Spaces. It encapsulates settings related to the editor's functionality, enabling users to customize the development experience for writing, editing, and managing code directly within the SageMaker environment, supporting streamlined workflows for machine learning and data science projects.

The `custom_file_system` block within the `space_settings` of the `aws_sagemaker_space` resource enables the integration of a user-defined file system with an Amazon SageMaker Space in an AI Domain. Configuring this block ensures scalable and secure storage tailored to the computational needs of SageMaker spaces.

The `space_storage_settings` block within the `space_settings` configuration of the `aws_sagemaker_space` resource defines storage-related configurations for SageMaker spaces, enabling users to manage how data is stored and accessed within the space environment. This block typically encapsulates settings for storage types, capacity, or access policies, allowing users to optimize data handling and ensure efficient resource utilization for machine learning workflows.

The `space_settings` block within the `aws_sagemaker_space` resource defines environment-specific configurations for a SageMaker space, enabling control over user access, resource limits, and operational settings. By configuring this block, users can tailor the workspace to meet specific requirements for machine learning development, ensuring optimized resource allocation and secure collaboration.
